title: Power Pages: performance and usage metrics in the Power Platform admin center monitor hub
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented administrative paths are supported, and searches confirmed the feature-specific documentation gaps. Microsoft gives conflicting general Monitor metric-retention periods; the briefing should mention the export documentation's 30-day window alongside the overview's 28 days.

claims.claim: No Power Pages-specific Monitor enablement or scoping switch is documented on the UI or automation surfaces.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages Monitor hub enable disable scoping tenant settings API; Power Pages Monitor default performance metrics. Read Monitor overview, tenant analytics, list tenant settings, Websites API and PAC excerpts; Copilot hub AI switches are for a different capability.

claims.claim: Monitor generally requires tenant-level analytics to be enabled.
claims.quote: Tenant-level analytics must be turned on to make data available for Monitor experiences.

claims.claim: The general analytics enablement path is Power Platform admin center > Manage > Tenant settings > Analytics > Tenant-level analytics > Enable > Save.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Tenant settings. On the Tenant settings page, select Analytics. In the Analytics pane, turn the Tenant-level analytics option to Enable. Select Save.

claims.claim: Monitor is an area of the Power Platform admin center for operational health reporting.
claims.quote: Your organization can use the Monitor area of the Power Platform admin center to measure and improve operational health metrics of resources that are built or deployed.

claims.claim: General Monitor aggregates runtime event logs into health metrics for admins and makers.
claims.quote: The Monitor experience is available to both makers ... and admins ... Metrics are calculated by aggregating daily event logs from runtime activity; they're not real-time.

claims.claim: Power Pages capacity management includes capacity and licensing views.
claims.quote: The Power Pages capacity management experience in the Power Platform admin center allows administrators to manage Power Pages capacity and monitor capacity consumption. This experience also provides an overview of the different licensing models in use.
